rules.V1_identity: for each static design, the 'medium' and 'relaxed' runs of the same seed have identical listener tables (every column of every table but EvaluationTime) in both generations; any difference fails tier 1's first requirement (R1) and stops the panel
rules.A1_continuity: relaxed: the largest step-to-step change of ReplicationData.criticalInitiationMass in any run is below 5 fg; medium: oxygen off shows its full jump at the shift (975 to 590 fg)
rules.A2_no_premature_division: relaxed: no generation of any downshift run lasts less than 600 s
rules.A3_rate_maintenance: relaxed oxygen off: the median length of the generations born after the shift (1 and 2) is at least the unshifted glucose median, 2,879 s (well4cell rc2), the organism's rate maintenance after a downshift (Zaritsky & Helmstetter 1992)
rules.negative_control: medium oxygen off: the same median falls below 2,879 s, reproducing the early divisions; if it does not, the panel cannot tell the rules apart and A3 is not decided
rules.upshift: oxygen restored: reported, not decided; the relaxed rule should reach glucose's cycle length sooner than the medium rule, whose cell must first grow to the higher threshold (Panlilio et al. 2021)
rules.decision: the registry record replication_initiation_after_a_nutrient_shift gains holds_in for 'relaxed' only if V1, A1, A2 and A3 pass and the negative control discriminates
rules.validity: a run counts only if it finishes every generation; a failed run is listed with its reason and never averaged; a design left with fewer than two runs reports no median

V3.not_read: WCECOLI_DOCKER is not set to the model image
